thread:
Jess (support): Customer ACME reports repeated tool-call failures from our hosted API and a large unexpected billing spike after yesterday's deploy. They see 422 schema validation + malformed args, but also auth token rotation errors. They attached repro steps and logs.

Priya (cust-success): Customer says they ran our sample request 500x as part of load test and saw sudden 50% error rate starting ~09:12 UTC. They got charged for all attempts and want a root cause + credit.

Jess (support): Quick paste of the failing request (from their support bundle):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwdl/tool-runner-v2","input":"run_search","tools":[{"name":"search","args":{"q":"query","extra_params":true}}]}'
```
Response: 422 {"error":"tool_call_schema_invalid","details":"Unexpected key: extra_params"} plus intermittent 401: token expired from auth service.

Miguel (eng-oncall): @Jess can you drop the full request id/time? I want to see if routing picked a fallback model. 401s could be unrelated if they rotated keys mid-test.

Jess (support): Request IDs: r-9a7c1 (09:11:52), r-9a7c2 (09:11:53)... failing window 09:12:00-09:16:00. Customer says they didn't rotate any keys. They also shared CI logs where our internal eval suite flagged the same schema case yesterday: run_tool_schema_tests -> FAILED on tool 'search' when args include boolean values.

Sam (qa): Reproduced locally with the sample payload — our validator rejects "extra_params" as expected, but the model is choosing the wrong tool signature in some generations and injecting extra fields. I saw this in a few golden-prompt regressions in the nightly eval: model outputs included a boolean field for 'filters' where schema expects object.

Anya (eng-ml): That's interesting. We rolled rwdl/tool-runner-v2:2026-03-12 that tightened schema inference to prefer strict tool match. It should reject extraneous fields, not accept them. But if the model emits a variant shape, downstream marshalling might coerce things and then the schema-checker raises 422. Did the customer use dedicated or hosted?

Priya (cust-success): Hosted. They used the default API key from their account.

Miguel (eng-oncall): Two separate issues to triage: (1) toolcall schema validation errors causing client errors (422) and contributing to billing for retries, and (2) intermittent 401s seen by customer -> need auth logs. I'll escalate the schema problem to eng-ml. @Anya can you look at the eval CI flakiness and golden prompts?

Anya (eng-ml): On it. Quick notes: our CI job run_tool_schema_tests uses the golden prompt set + schema fuzzing. Last night's run had 3 flakes where the model produced extra fields, and our regression alert didn't fire because the threshold was 10% and this was 6%. I'll pull those examples and attach to the ticket.

Jess (support): Customer requested repro steps we can run from their context (hosted key). I've asked them for a sanitized key but they don't want to share keys. They allowed us to replay from logs, paste below is sanitized request batch.

Jess (support): Repro steps from support POV:
1) Send the curl above repeatedly (500x at ~50rps)
2) Observe 422 errors containing 'tool_call_schema_invalid' and occasional 401s in the same window
3) Check billing dashboard for token counts spikes in that timeframe

Sam (qa): I wrote a small test harness that replays the same payloads and asserts that tool selection and args match the schema. Run snippet:
```python
# run harness
for i in range(100):
  resp = client.generate(...payload... )
  if resp.status_code == 422:
    log(resp.json())
```
I can run this against a staging copy if someone grants a staging key.

Miguel (eng-oncall): I'll pull auth gateway logs for that time window. If tokens were invalidated server-side (KMS key rotation or token introspection glitch) we'll see it. Also creating INC-2026-021 (internal incident) to track billing review and possible credit.

Anya (eng-ml): Preliminary findings: two golden prompts in the nightly eval produced unexpected keys: `extra_params` (boolean) and `filters` (boolean). These map to a new prompt variant introduced in a training dataset change on 2026-03-11. Model generation probability for those templates is low (3-7%), but under load they surfaced more often. CI threshold missed it.

Anya (eng-ml): Proposed mitigation: revert the prompt variant from the fine-tune set and add a hard sanitizer in the tool-call marshaller to drop unknown keys (short-term). Also add a CI alert if flakiness > 2% on schema tests.

Priya (cust-success): Customer asked for ETA on fix and credit for the extra charges. They want immediate mitigation so they can continue testing.

Miguel (eng-oncall): Action items:
- @Anya: add sanitizer + open PR to marshaller to ignore unknown keys (TICKET: INF-4492). If tests pass, ship a hotfix to hosted by EOD.
- @Sam: run harness against staging once sanitizer is in place to verify regression removed.
- @Jess/@Priya: keep customer updated, collect a full list of request IDs for billing review.
- I'll review auth logs and follow up on 401 root cause.

Sam (qa): I'll also add dedicated testcases for boolean->object mismatches and add them to the golden prompt suite.

Jess (support): Noted. Communicated temporary workaround to customer: avoid sending booleans in tool args and try single-run instead of burst. They accepted a temporary rate-limited replay for 50 requests while we investigate.

Anya (eng-ml): I'll open PR for sanitizer and CI threshold change now. Will link PR and CI run in this thread.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/hotfix/marshaller-sanitizer -> staging

Miguel (eng-oncall): Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. If we confirm hosted hotfix fixes customer, we can propose a billing credit and mark the incident resolved. :white_check_mark:

Jess (support): Updating customer with interim fix plan and expected timeline (4-6 hours). I'll post customer confirmation here once they try the 50-request replay.

Priya (cust-success): Customer will try replay in ~30m and report.

Jess (support): Closing loop for now, saving attachments to INC-2026-021.

Anya (eng-ml): PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inf/PR-1234 (sanitizer). Tests added to run_tool_schema_tests and threshold adjusted.

Sam (qa): Staging run after sanitizer: 1000 replays, 0 schema failures, no duplicate auth 401s observed in staging.

Priya (cust-success): Customer replayed 50 requests: all succeeded. They confirmed errors stopped during the sanitized window. Asking about credit now.

Miguel (eng-oncall): Auth log follow-up: 401s were due to a transient token cache eviction in gateway at 09:12:11 that affected ~0.05% of requests; we've patched TTL handling. Recording separate RCA for that.

Jess (support): Customer wants formal RCA + billing credit. I've created billing request BR-884 and attached INC-2026-021 notes and the staging test evidence.

Miguel (eng-oncall): Marking this thread resolved for immediate outage; will keep postmortem in postmortems/ after full RCA.

Jess (support): Thanks all.
